jobs.title: AI & Digital Products Consultant (Strategy & Transformation Practice)
jobs.description:
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

Bain has formalized industry and capability “Practices” that are integral to how Bain wins and delivers results to its clients. Together they form our  Product, Practice, and Knowledge ("PPK") team . The role of a Practice is to drive growth for Bain in a particular industry or capability together with offices, and boost Bain’s expertise and commercial excellence.

The Strategy & Transformation Practice is one of the largest practices at Bain, and at the heart of some of our biggest client success stories. We’re constantly pushing the boundaries of innovation, with new hooks, points of view, products, tools and delivery models that bring together the best thinking from our most successful client heads and senior strategists, to stretch our client’s definition of full potential, embed change within their organizations, and deliver results. The Strategy & Transformation Practice team works very closely with partners, senior managers and teams to bring Bain’s best experience and the latest tools and innovations to bear across sectors and offices. They are integral in helping Bain win new cases and advising our case teams on difficult strategy and transformation questions.

The Strategy Practice Consultant role is part of our Business & Corporate Strategy solution team, which consists of two Global Solution Leaders, a Global Solution & IP VP, a Practice Director, a Solution Technical Product Manager, a Solution Innovation Practice Senior Manager, multiple Practice Managers, Consultants and BCN who collectively manage the overall solution IP, IP/tool development, and commercial deployment, and a knowledge management team. The role focuses on turning our Bain IP and differentiated capabilities into practical, high-impact approaches and AI-enabled tools (housed within the “Full Potential Co-Pilot” suite of S&T tools) for frontline partners and strategy case teams. You will be helping Bain stay at the forefront of innovation, harnessing technology to enhance the way we solve strategic business problems.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

The Strategy Practice Consultant role is a critical one for the Strategy & Transformation Practice, supporting Strategy product and IP development and deployment, and client and case team support. The individual will help drive our solution modernization efforts, with a focus on the development of innovative technology solutions that embed into the Strategy solutions, working closely with the rest of the practice team and others innovating on AI tools within Bain.

1) Solution Incubation: Help discover, prototype, and scale high-value tools as part of the Full Potential Co-Pilot suite of S&T-driven use cases
- Identify and prioritize opportunities for AI modules for prototyping through frontline learnings
- Help translate IP and business logic into prototypes of proprietary tools to be tested using no/low-code platforms (e.g., Claude skills); evaluate outputs and iterate on tools, in partnership with Solution Innovation SM
- Work with the solution team to continuously evolve all S&T-owned modules (prompts, data calls, guardrails, etc.) based on ongoing evals and pattern recognition from frontline use
- Collaborate with Knowledge Management team to curate and harness “citizen innovation” that happens within Strategy case teams, integrating high value tools into the standard workflow / platform for reuse across Bain

2) Tool Deployment / Team Support: Work with practice team to embed AI tools and insights into case team engagements
- Support high-priority Strategy pitches with cutting-edge AI insights
- Partner with case teams to weave AI tools into live engagements from day one
- Identify case team innovations that should be scaled
- Track usage and outcome metrics and circulate best practices across case teams

3) Marketing and Training: Help drive firm-wide awareness and adoption of Strategy tools and innovation
- Work with solution team to embed tools into Strategy approach, core IP collateral, Iris/Sage
- Lead hands-on trainings to boost adoption and confidence across Bain’s Strategy General Consulting staff and Practice team
- Create demo videos, one-pagers and pitch decks to market the practice’s tools
- Maintain usage dashboards and success stories

4) Solution Innovation Strategy: Help shape the vision, priorities, and roadmap for solution innovation, working closely with the Solution Innovation SM, Global Solution Leaders, Global Solution and IP VP, Solution Technical Product Manager and other key stakeholders
- Help coordinate collaboration efforts with key stakeholders and resource groups across Bain including the Core Innovation Team, Vector, Umbrage, BCN/BCN Labs, Modernize Bain and S&T Leadership
- Conduct ongoing research to monitor competitor offerings and tech/AI advancements and translate into insights that inform product roadmap and investment decisions

ABOUT YOU

- 5-8 years technical product development experience in a similar industry with an undergraduate degree OR 4-5 years experience with MBA/Master’s OR MBB consulting experience at the Senior Associate or Consultant level OR Senior Consultant Level at other management consulting firms
- Strong understanding of AI/ML technologies and tools (e.g., Python, R, OpenAI APIs), and extensive experience building AI-enabled tools that create business value
- Analytical and problem- solving skills and expertise to push insights to conclusive recommendations
- Ability to effectively drive a piece of work end-to-end with limited direction
- Continuously learns from one experience to another and makes thoughtful recommendations on improvements
- Excellent verbal and written skills in English Language at a C1 level
- Structure and design impactful slides and written updates; can clearly communicate insights and implications of work to senior stakeholders at the right level of detail
- Steer and direct highly effective small meetings; participates in meetings with more senior stakeholders and appropriately shares opinion
- Track record of inspiring, motivating, and apprenticing junior team members
- Flexibility to work outside usual business hours to accommodate for the global nature of the role working across timezones

jobs.title: AI & Digital Products Consultant (Sustainability Practice)
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

Over the past two decades, Bain has formalized Industry and Capability areas, internally known as “Practices”, integral to how Bain wins and delivers results to its clients. A Practice can be considered a Business Unit of Bain & Company. While there may be some allocation to client-facing work, the role within a Practice is primarily focused on supporting our client-facing partners and case teams to deliver great client and people success stories. Specifically, the Practice defines and implements their own strategy and allocates resources to:
Boosts Bain’s knowledge and expertise in the sector or capability: co-create, shape and manage innovative perspectives and products to help the business win more projects, and to serve clients more effectively and efficiently
- Prioritize clients and enable client full potential
- Develop partner team and capabilities
- Build the practice’s brand and reputation externally

For an overview of Bain’s Industry and Capability Practice architecture, visit www.Bain.com .

WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM

Sustainability (which covers environmental, social, and economic justice issues) is an increasingly important topic for our clients. In the Sustainability Practice, we help our clients make critical decisions that impact the core of their business strategy, related to sustainability strategy, the environmental and social impact of operations, stakeholder engagement, and sustainability-related growth and cost opportunities. We work to ensure that sustainability efforts are anchored in business fundamentals and demonstrate a clear return on investment – and that those efforts are then firmly embedded within our clients' strategy and operations.

Read more about our Sustainability consulting services to learn more about our work.

The Practice Consultant is a critical member of the Sustainability Practice, and the analytical, interpersonal, creative thinking, business management and leadership skills will be called upon from day one. You will also work alongside the Practice team to become a critical contributor to help achieve the Practice’s annual and longer-term goals which includes driving global collaboration, supporting case teams to drive results with clients, building new intellectual property (IP) and increasing our visibility and reinforcing our competitive differentiation externally.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

The scope of work is flexible but will likely fall into the following main categories.

Solution design, development, deployment, and delivery
- Develop elements of specific IP, including global reports, research briefs, market overviews and solution/topic specific materials tailored to specific sectors/industries
- Support planning for commercializing IP and solution development, for example by developing business cases for investment, including ROI modeling, impact assessment, and commercialization planning
- Provide hands-on support for clients and case teams, for example in leveraging technology solutions
- Build elements of training materials for affiliates on latest IP
- Identify issues, create hypotheses, and execute analysis; translate data into meaningful insights; present recommendations to key decision-makers
- Support the day-to-day implementation of transformation projects, focusing primarily on the delivery and operationalization of strategic initiatives to achieve significant business outcomes and impact
- Run analysis and support business case development for solution investments
- Contribute to digital and AI scaling efforts by identifying opportunities to embed automation, analytics, and emerging technologies that enhance delivery and impact

Practice strategy, planning, and reporting
- Support data collection, maintenance, and analysis on experts and commercial collateral
- Provide direct proposal support
- Bring together disparate data sources; highlight issues and spot trends to inform decision-making
- Drive and support the primary and secondary research efforts of the team; collect and analyze quantitative and qualitative data across a variety of sources
- Codify best practices
- Contribute to additional projects and perform select ad hoc analytics
- Contribute to a culture of innovation by surfacing new ideas, sharing learnings from pilots, and championing the use of emerging technologies within the practice

Practice communications and teaming
- Work effectively cross-practice and cross-functionally; proactively share and solicit information across practice, focusing on the key implications
- Train and informally coach junior team members, as appropriate

ABOUT YOU

Education & Experience
- 5-8 years top tier management consultant or equivalent experience + undergrad, or 4-5 years experience with MBA/Master’s

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
- Analytical and problem- solving skills and expertise to push insights to conclusive recommendations
- Ability to effectively drive a piece of work end-to-end with limited direction
- Can perform complex, accurate analysis
- Continuously learns from one experience to another and makes thoughtful recommendations on improvements
- Structure and design impactful slides and updates; can clearly communicate insights and implications of work
- Steer and direct highly effective small meetings; participates in meetings with more senior stakeholders and appropriately shares opinion
- Track record of inspiring, motivating and apprenticing junior team members
- Passion for sustainability and deploying cutting-edge sustainability techniques and tools that help clients accelerate their growth and reach full potential
- Familiarity with AI/ML technologies and tools (e.g., Python, R, OpenAI APIs), with an applied understanding of how they can create business value
- Comfort with AI technologies and tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Grok), with an applied understanding of how they can create business value
- Interest for the tech industry broadly (e.g., digital transformation, disruptive business models)
- Fluency in English

Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
- Demonstrated product thinking: able to frame user needs, inform feature prioritization, and guide digital solution development in partnership with technical teams
- Experience working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical teams, including engineers, product managers, and sustainability experts
- Familiarity with machine learning workflows and tools (e.g., model training, evaluation, or deployment), with the ability to collaborate effectively with data scientists/ML engineers
- Ability to communicate technical or digital concepts to non-technical stakeholders

jobs.title: Analyst with French, Revenue E2E
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the #1 ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor’s list since its founding in 2009. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
You will join the End-to-End (E2E) Revenue team, a global function responsible for ensuring accurate, timely and compliant revenue operations across Bain's client engagements. Working closely with case teams, Finance colleagues and client Accounts Payable contacts, you will support the end-to-end revenue process - from billing preparation and revenue posting to reconciliations and query resolution. You will collaborate with colleagues across regions and functions while contributing to operational excellence and delivering a high-quality internal and external client experience.

WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM
As an Analyst, Revenue (E2E Team), you will play an important role in supporting day-to-day revenue operations for assigned clients and case teams. You will help ensure billing accuracy, maintain revenue integrity, and contribute to timely month-end close activities. Working alongside experienced team members, you will build expertise in revenue processes, systems and controls while developing strong relationships with internal stakeholders and supporting continuous process improvements.

WHAT YOU’LL DO
- Prepare draft invoices and supporting documentation for review and approval, ensuring completeness and accuracy.
- Post standard revenue transactions, accruals and adjustments in accordance with established policies and procedures.
- Reconcile case and financial data across revenue systems, including Workday, Agiloft and reporting tools, identifying and resolving discrepancies.
- Monitor accounts receivable aging and support follow-up activities with case teams and client Accounts Payable contacts on outstanding invoices.
- Investigate and resolve routine billing, revenue and client queries, escalating more complex issues to senior team members when appropriate.
- Support month-end close activities by preparing reconciliations, accruals and audit documentation to ensure timely financial reporting.
- Maintain accurate revenue records while ensuring compliance with internal controls, accounting standards and company policies.
- Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency by contributing to process enhancements and standarization initiatives.
- Collaborate with Finance colleagues, case teams and global stakeholders to deliver a seamless revenue management experience.
- Build working knowledge of revenue systems, billing processes and financial controls while continuously developing technical and analytical skills.

ABOUT YOU
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting or a related field.
- 2-4 years of experience in billing, accounts receivable, revenue accounting, finance or a related field.
- Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
- Advanced knowledge of French, both written and spoken.
- Solid Excel skills, including lookups, pivot tables and basic financial reconciliations.
- Understanding of accounting, billing and revenue recognition concepts.
- Experience working with ERP or billing systems such as Workday, Agiloft or similar platforms is an advantage.
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify discrepancies, investigate issues and recommend appropriate solutions.
- Excellent attention to detail, accuracy and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Clear written and verbal communication skills, with confidence interacting professionally with internal stakeholders and client contacts.
- Curiosity, ownership, and a continuous learning mindset, with the ability to adapt to new systems, processes and technologies.
- Interest in leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copolit and other digital solutions to enhance productivity and improve operational efficiency.
- Collaborative, proactive and adaptable team player committed to delivering high-quality service and operational excellence.
- Ability to thrive in a hybrid work environment, with and expectation of working 2 days per week from the office in Warsaw and 3 days remotely.

jobs.description:

The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.

About M&A CoE
- M&A Center of Excellence (CoE) at BCN is a new CoE being established to support Bain’s capabilities for M&A And Divestitures practice
- Bain’s M&A CoE offerings will include offerings across Growth and M&A Strategy, Deal Sourcing and Screening, Corporate Due Diligence (Integration thesis and Synergies modules) , Merger Integration, Divestiture and Separation. The CoE will play a crucial role in improving and further differentiating Bain’s approach across these offerings.
- The M&A CoE will actively support Bain Partners/ Global Case teams across and Client Cases/ Client development efforts
- Additionally, the CoE will also work closely with M&A and Divestitures practice/solution leadership in building new IP/ Products/ Tools etc.
- CoE scope and scale is expected to evolve over time to more deeper domain expertise, broader scope and end-to-end offerings. Plan is to also expand the CoE to BCN Mexico in future.

About You
- A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with strong academic background
- 2-4 years of prior domain experience/ relevant expertise e,g. Synergy analysis (and/or cost diagnostics), Due Diligence (M&A or Private Equity), Merger Integration, Divestiture strategy, etc
- Strong analytical skills with proven ability of leveraging/ embracing automation / AI to drive efficiency across products/ offerings.
- High-level competence in core analytical tools such as Alteryx, Tableau, Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
- Hands-on skills in research and analytics are required, along with significant exposure to key secondary data sources. A robust consulting and problem-solving skill set tied with a background in marketing analytics is also necessary
- Fundamental skills include excellent work planning, communication, and team leading abilities. Relevant experience with data analytics, project and team management, coaching, and mentoring is also required

What You’ll Do
- Works under the guidance of the Project Leader / Manager, playing a key role in driving the team’s overall answer, final materials, client communication, work planning. Brainstorming with the supervisor on various aspects for IP development, CD, case work as needed
- Ensure timely, high quality, error-free research, analysis and output. Drive insights through data analysis – Story-lining the deliverable to prove/disprove hypotheses
- Works with project/case teams across geographies and industries; however, they focus almost exclusively M&A related projects/ cases
- Have structured communication skills and a willingness to learn the consulting toolkit to be able to translate analytical insights into business impacts
- Brings to the table various cutting-edge technologies and best practices in a productized delivery model; adoption of AI/ agentic tools for driving efficiency
- Communicate effectively and clearly explain insights and implications for the client
- Openness to transfer to Mexico / help set-up M&A in Mexico will be an added advantage

What makes us a great place to work
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the #1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH:

This is an opportunity to be part of Bain’s Capital Projects Center of Expertise (CoE), based out of the Gurugram office, specifically supporting Bain’s Capital Projects & Infrastructure practice on live cases, client development and proposal support. The Capital Projects CoE works across major capital programs spanning energy, infrastructure, transport, oil & gas, power & utilities, mining and large industrial build-outs.
As part of the Capital Projects team, you will get exposed to case delivery and client development activities for clients executing large, complex capital programs. The primary objective is to collaborate with practice and case teams on the development and deployment of project-controls, PMO and digital capabilities that answer strategic questions for Bain’s capital-intensive clients — from project setup and assurance through delivery and turnaround.
An Associate works as a team member / contributor on BCN cases, driving the analysis on complex cases with some direction from a Project Leader and occasionally leading simple cases independently. In addition, Associates help mentor and coach Analysts by providing regular guidance / feedback and progressively take on greater ownership of workstreams.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

- Day-to-day management of 2-3 team members

- Lead a small team of Analysts and Jr. Associates, owning day-to-day delivery with limited PL/Manager oversight
- Understand and translate the client's context and business problem into a clear, prioritized work plan
- Create the work plan, provide guidance to junior team members, and review outputs to ensure high-quality delivery to clients
- Anticipate roadblocks, resolve them at source, and escalate early when needed

- Program governance & PMO operations

- Design and stand up PMO operating models — stage-gate governance, change control, RACI, decision logs, escalation paths — and assess the robustness of a client's existing setup
- Build and interrogate the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS): run critical-path, what-if, and schedule-compression analyses that underpin recommendations

- Cost & performance controls

- Build cost-control and Earned Value analyses (budget phasing, CPI/SPI, forecast-at-completion, variance) to pinpoint where a program is over budget or behind schedule
- Create executive-ready dashboards that give client leadership a decision-grade view of project health

- Risk & safety management

- Build the analytical backbone for risk reviews — risk registers, quantified mitigations, contingency strategies — and turn findings into recommendations the team can land with the client

- Digital & advanced analytics

- Shape the digital roadmap and success metrics for client programs, including 5D BIM (cost + schedule) and model-based quantity management
- Apply advanced scheduling and risk analytics — constraint-based planning, scenario simulation, Monte Carlo — to quantify outcomes and de-risk recommendations
- Build Power BI / Tableau control towers and pilot AI tools that speed delivery and leave the client with reusable assets

ABOUT YOU:

- Relevant experience of 2-5 years for undergraduates and 0-3 years for postgraduates from a top-tier college with a strong academic record and 3-4 years of relevant experience in capital projects, project controls, PMO or management consulting
- PMP® certification or active progress toward it is an advantage (not mandatory at this level)
- Hands-on with at least 2–3 of: Project controls, P6/MS Project, Power BI/Tableau, BIM (Navisworks/Revit/Synchro), EVM, ALICE – Generative Scheduling, AI tools
- Strong analytical, MS Office, communication, problem-solving, and team-player skills; able to handle multiple tasks and work under pressure

jobs.title: Associate Director, Bain Academy
jobs.location: Amsterdam, Boston, Chicago, Dallas, Dubai, London, San Francisco, Toronto, Zurich
jobs.description:
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
You’ll join Bain Academy, a global team that helps clients and executives build the capabilities they need to deliver lasting results. We design and deliver customized, immersive learning experiences that strengthen leadership, accelerate results, and build enduring promoters of Bain.
Our portfolio includes more than 100 masterclasses on topics such as strategic thinking, RAPID® decision effectiveness, Agile innovation, generative AI, consultative selling, business storytelling, Net Promoter System, influencing others, and high-performing teams. We also develop executive programs that strengthen general management and leadership capabilities, as well as blended learning experiences that combine live workshops with self-paced digital learning.
We are passionate about unleashing potential and creating impact through learning, application, and continuous development.

WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM
As an Associate Director in Bain Academy, you’ll design and deliver high-impact, interactive learning programs for clients across in-person, virtual, and digital formats. You’ll serve as a thought leader and content creator, collaborating with experts across Bain to develop capability-building content that inspires, engages, and drives measurable change.
You’ll advise Bain case teams on capability-building opportunities, lead workshops for priority clients, and help shape Bain Academy’s global strategy as we continue to scale.
This role draws on the core skills of an experienced consulting leader: developing compelling content, solving complex problems, facilitating workshops, influencing senior stakeholders, and managing a diverse range of relationships. The role may involve approximately 20–25% travel, with flexibility depending on your focus and interests.

WHAT YOU’LL DO
Deliver world-class learning experiences
- Advise Client Heads, Office Heads, and case teams on client capability-building needs.
- Share expertise on learning and development topics with Bain and client leadership teams.
- Identify and share relevant materials to support capability-building proposals and client discussions.
- Provide rapid-response support to Bain teams seeking capability-building content and expertise.
- Partner with account teams on client development activities, including contributing to proposals.
- Lead and co-deliver Bain Academy programs, tailoring design and content to the client context.
- Design and facilitate engaging workshops, Train the Trainer sessions, and blended learning programs.
- Support high-quality program execution, from aligning with clients on the approach through event delivery and participant follow-up.

Build and evolve Bain Academy learning assets
- Work closely with solution leaders and experts to design high-impact training modules and immersive exercises.
- Develop learning experiences across topics such as Agile innovation, sales effectiveness, Net Promoter System, procurement, and performance transformation.
- Adapt internal Bain training content for external audiences.
- Develop blended learning journeys that combine live and digital experiences.
- Help shape Bain’s point of view on capability building and contribute to the evolution of our digital learning strategy.
- Curate relevant external content and collaborate with colleagues across Bain.
- Explore and pilot creative learning techniques and formats, including simulations, gamification, interactive exercises, and emerging technologies.

Recent examples of Bain Academy work include immersive Agile and innovation training; sales learning journeys supported by AI-powered coaching; blended Net Promoter System learning programs; a procurement curriculum incorporating an interactive strategy board game; and programs that equip Bain teams and clients to support large-scale performance transformations.
Drive Bain Academy’s growth and strategy
- Partner with senior leadership to refine and implement Bain Academy’s global strategy.
- Develop marketing materials and build internal awareness and demand for Bain Academy offerings.
- Contribute to periodic strategy reviews focused on maximizing client impact.

Contribute to Bain’s internal learning programs
While this role is primarily focused on Bain Academy’s client-facing offerings, you may also have opportunities to support priority internal learning programs depending on demand, capacity, and personal interest. Examples include working styles, personal productivity, facilitation skills, Agile, and new learning-content development.

ABOUT YOU
You bring consulting experience, a passion for learning design and delivery, and the confidence to step seamlessly into client-facing situations as both a subject matter expert and trusted advisor.
You will also bring:
- Current or recent experience as a Bain consulting Senior Manager, with a rating of “Strong Impact/Contribution” or higher in your most recent professional development review, or demonstrated mastery of the Manager, Bain Academy role.
- A demonstrated passion for training, with experience as a trainer at a global program preferred.
- Experience managing teams in project-based environments.
- Strong communication and facilitation skills, with fluency in written and spoken English.
- A creative, detail-oriented, execution-focused approach and the ability to adapt to evolving needs.
- The ability to work independently and take initiative with limited direction.
- The ability to work effectively across global teams, including flexibility to adjust priorities and working hours to meet client needs.
- Willingness to travel.
- A high level of discretion when managing confidential and sensitive information.
- A personal commitment to lifelong learning.
- Knowledge, certification, or experience in areas such as product management, MBTI, Agile/Scrum, Net Promoter System, coaching, or coding.

You are collaborative and know how to work with and through others to deliver results. You are entrepreneurial, proactive, and energized by building something new. You combine insight, creativity, and problem-solving with a pragmatic understanding of what will work for clients and teams.
You also bring energy and enthusiasm to learning experiences, communicate in a way that inspires others, and are comfortable working in a global, remote-first environment. Above all, you are a supportive colleague and teammate whom clients and Bain colleagues enjoy working with.

WHAT BAIN ACADEMY CAN OFFER YOU
- Professional development: Build deep expertise in capability building and Bain’s priority solution areas, with access to external certifications and training opportunities.
- Senior stakeholder exposure: Work with senior executives and Bain leadership around the world.
- Lasting impact through people development: Help clients and colleagues build capabilities, deliver results, and advance their careers.
- Entrepreneurial growth: Help shape Bain Academy’s strategy, innovate in learning, and drive new initiatives.
- A high-performing, creative team: Collaborate with colleagues who are passionate about learning, impact, and creating an enjoyable working environment.

WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

US Compensation Information

Compensation for this role includes base salary, annual discretionary performance bonus, 401(k) plan with an annual employer contribution based on years of service and Bain’s best in class benefits package (details listed below).

Some local governments in the United States require a good-faith, reasonable salary range to be included in job postings for open roles. The estimated annualized compensation for this role is as follows:

- In Massachusetts, Illinois, California, Texas, New York the good-faith, reasonable annualized full-time salary range for this role is between $164,500 - $219,000 ,  placement within this range will vary based on several factors including, but not limited to experience, education, licensure/certifications, training and skill level
- Annual discretionary performance bonus

- This role may also be eligible for other elements of discretionary compensation

- 4.5% 401(k) company contribution, which increases after 3 years of service and is 100% vested upon start date

Bain & Company's comprehensive benefits and wellness program is designed to help employees achieve personal independence, protection and stability in the areas most important to you and your family.

- Bain pays 100% individual employee premiums for medical, dental and vision programs, offering one of the most comprehensive medical plans for employees without impacting your paycheck
- Generous paid time off, including parental leave, sick leave and paid holidays
- Fully vested 401(k) company contribution
- Paid Life and Long-Term Disability insurance

For all other locations, the good-faith, reasonable annualized full-time salary range for this role is commensurate with competitive geographic market rates for this role and will vary based on several factors including, but not limited to experience, education, licensure/certifications, training and skill level

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
You’ll join our Global Travel & Expense team, working with colleagues across regions and markets to support timely and accurate employee expense processing. You’ll also collaborate with local office stakeholders, including employees and Finance and Human Resources teams, to provide guidance, resolve issues, and support consistent Travel & Expense processes.

WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM
As an Associate, Global Travel & Expense, you’ll play a key role in supporting the Travel & Expense team by ensuring employee expense reports are processed accurately and on time.
You’ll take ownership of your assigned market, help maintain compliance with company policies, manage your responsibilities efficiently, and contribute to the team’s overall service standards and objectives.

WHAT YOU’LL DO
- Review employee expense submissions for accuracy, completeness, appropriate documentation, and compliance with company Travel & Expense policies.
- Take ownership of your assigned market and ensure audits are completed in line with company policy and agreed service levels.
- Support timely employee reimbursement, with a goal of reimbursement within two weeks of expense submission.
- Provide backup support across the team and take on additional scope when required.
- Partner with regional and global team members to balance workloads, respond to volume fluctuations, and support shared service-delivery goals.
- Identify unusual trends, policy deviations, and nonstandard items, escalating concerns appropriately and highlighting situations that may require clarification, exception handling, or additional approval.
- Respond to employee inquiries and resolve system-related issues in a timely and professional manner.
- Manage service tickets in line with agreed service levels, responding within 24 hours for urgent tickets and within two days for standard tickets.
- Build and maintain strong working relationships with employees and local Finance and Human Resources stakeholders.
- Facilitate training for new joiners within your markets, including guidance on Travel & Expense policies, expense-system navigation, submissions, and service-ticket logging.
- Prepare and deliver monthly duplicate and open-items reports for assigned auditor markets, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely submission.
- Contribute to broader team objectives and process improvements where possible.

ABOUT YOU
- You have proficiency in English, both written and verbal.
- You have strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy when reviewing and entering data.
- You have good time-management and organizational skills and can work effectively against processing deadlines.
- You communicate clearly and professionally when responding to employee questions.
- You can follow structured procedures and know when to escalate issues.
- You are proficient in Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel and Outlook.
- You can learn and adapt quickly to changes in systems and policies.
- You work effectively in a team-oriented, global environment.
- You can handle repetitive tasks with consistency and reliability.
- You maintain confidentiality and integrity when working with sensitive information.
- You have a basic understanding of Travel & Expense processes and policy compliance.
- You are familiar with expense systems and documentation requirements for expense processing.
- You have an awareness of general finance, accounts payable, or administrative workflows.
- You are able to work full-time and, once training is complete and performance is established, work remotely from home on some days each week.
- Tertiary education in Accounting or Finance is a plus.

jobs.description:

In this role, you’ll focus primarily on coordinating the hiring of Associate Consultants and Consultants through our Experienced Hiring channel. You’ll work closely with recruiting teammates and a broad range of internal and external stakeholders to deliver a high-quality candidate experience.

WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM

This is an opportunity to gain broad exposure to recruiting in a dynamic, fast-paced and professional environment. You’ll play an important role in keeping our Experienced Hiring processes running smoothly, supporting candidates and interview teams throughout the recruiting journey.

You’ll thrive in this role if you’re highly organised, eager to learn and motivated to consistently deliver high-quality work.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Quickly get up to speed and gain a strong understanding of recruiting systems and local processes
- Support the CV screening process, keeping to deadlines and gaining screening expertise over time
- Support the management of interview day logistics - Facilitate smooth-running of interview days including scheduling, creating interview packs, organising catering, etc.

- Attend recruiting events and interview days with teammates as needed, managing interview teams and being point person to internal and external stakeholders
- Support teammates as required through closing:  - Including updating Avature, creating closing tracker, etc.
- Supporting the organisation of offeree events e.g. plan daily agenda, coordinate all logistics, schedule speakers, order gifts, book venues, etc.
- Prepare and send offeree gifts

- Ownership of EH inbox, ensuring efficient turnaround on all candidate interactions and requests
- Support project work on an ad-hoc basis
- Ownership of specific candidate events and presentations, including preparation of materials, all logistics, and attending events
- Source case study coaches and coordinate candidate coaching sessions in a timely manner
- Support with the updating and maintenance of data on key systems, e.g. Avature

jobs.title: Expert Associate Consultant, Tech Insights Group
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK
We are proud to be consistently recognised as one of the world's best places to work. Bain has ranked as the top consulting firm on Glassdoor's Best Places to Work list every year since the rankings began in 2009, and has earned the #1 overall spot seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don't happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
Tech Insights Group (TIG) at Bain & Company is a rapidly growing global team of world-class consultants and technologists. We work with leading Private Equity (PE) investors and their tech-enabled portfolio companies to act as technical advisors in investment processes. We conduct product and technology due diligence engagements and value creation assignments, leveraging our extensive expertise in software and understanding of commercial environments specific to tech-enabled businesses. We deliver our projects by combining a team of consultants with CPOs and CTOs of leading global technology and software companies with decades of both advising and operating experience. The team has completed 400+ product and technology diligences and value creation engagements worldwide.

Over the past 4 years, we supported our clients on some of the most visible technology investments in the US and Europe, including several of the Top 2024 and Top 2025 software deals. We conduct engagements spanning enterprise applications, vertical applications (HCIT, FinTech, EdTech), infrastructure software, cloud software, and tech enabled services (IT services, e-Commerce, AdTech). We also help funds understand GenAI disruption potential and opportunities to inform their investment thesis. Bain's Tech Insights practice is a place where agile minds work powerfully and nimbly together, thriving on spirited discussion.

The Tech Insights Group operates within the Expert Client Delivery (ECD) team, a global capability area designed to provide support to clients across Europe and beyond through a single, globally organized team. TIG enhances our Private Equity Group (PEG) and General Consulting (GC) capabilities by offering specialized technical expertise to support our clients at every stage of the investment lifecycle from deal generation and due diligence to portfolio value creation and exit planning.

WHAT YOU’LL DO
You will get deep exposure and access to the leading software and tech enabled companies globally, typically 10-20 companies each year. On cases, you will work closely with our global experts comprising former CTOs and CPOs of leading global technology and software companies, leading private equity investor clients, and our general consulting and commercial diligence teams. This is a particularly exciting time to join the team – we have ambitious growth plans and you will be contributing to scaling a growing global capability within Bain & Company.
- Perform primary and secondary research: collect and analyze quantitative and qualitative data across a variety of sources to test or further our understanding of the business or market
- Product strategy and roadmap assessments: contribute to the assessment of product capabilities, positioning, and roadmap completeness and viability
- Technology strategy and roadmap assessments: contribute to the assessment of architectures (current and future), technical debt, and related areas such as hosting and security
- Develop and communicate insights and recommendations to the case team members, technology leaders, and PE investors

ABOUT YOU
- Undergraduate/Master’s degree from a top tier university in a relevant field (i.e., computer science, data science, statistics, information systems, engineering, business management).
- We are looking for candidates in their penultimate year of study, or those with less than two years of full-time work experience

- Passion for software  - Demonstrate a passion for software as well as the tech industry more broadly (e.g., digital transformation, disruptive business models)
- Ability to absorb and interpret technical information

- Client service orientation and EQ - Passion for delivering high-impact client results
- Strong interpersonal skills and emotional agility
- Outstanding oral and written communication skills

- Analytical and data-driven mindset

- Inquisitive mindset and eager to learn
- Aptitude for creative, quantitative, and qualitative problem solving.

- Entrepreneurial mindset and teamwork  - Entrepreneurial, curious, creative, and innovative thinking
- Strong belief in agile continuous improvement principles
- Strong alignment with Bain operating principles
- Strong teamwork ethos and ability to work with team members with diverse skills and backgrounds in an inclusive fashion

- Language requirements - Professional fluency in English required
- Fluency in French/ German is a plus

YOUR CAREER
Throughout your career at Bain you will participate in world class formal and informal training programmes in order to ensure you continuously develop your skills. In addition, you will be assigned a mentor to help guide you through your career and will develop a network of your peers across teams and offices. Working alongside an outstanding group of individuals, you will develop and enhance your own technology expertise, commercial acumen, and analytical capabilities. Whether your long-term goal is to grow with us, join a PE/VC firm, work in the tech/software industry, or to start the next great technology company, you will build a fantastic foundation by joining our multi-talented and highly motivated team.

jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
You’ll join Bain’s  Technology Solutions Group (TSG) and work closely with teams across Global Technology Operations, Product Engineering, Service Management, Security Operations, and other technology functions around the world.
You’ll lead a globally distributed Tier 2 Operations capability spanning infrastructure, digital workplace, and cloud operations. You’ll also lead our Vulnerability and Patch Management Centre of Excellence, partnering across technology and security teams to strengthen service reliability, operational consistency, vulnerability remediation, and readiness across our global technology environment.

WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM
As IT Operations Director, you’ll lead the day-to-day operations of our consolidated Tier 2 support function, serving as a key point of escalation and coordination between Tier 1 support teams and Tier 3 Product Engineering teams.

You’ll turn our Tier 2 operating model into consistent, scalable ways of working across infrastructure, cloud, and digital workplace support. This includes establishing shared support practices, playbooks, escalation frameworks, operating rhythms, and performance standards.

You’ll also own and lead our Vulnerability and Patch Management Centre of Excellence across global technology operations. You’ll be accountable for the end-to-end patching lifecycle, vulnerability remediation standards, compliance reporting, and automated remediation workflows, working closely with Security Operations to ensure vulnerabilities and zero-day exposures are consistently triaged, remediated, and evidenced.

A key part of your role will be advancing the maturity of our technology operations through observability, automation, disciplined incident response, and continuous improvement. You’ll identify opportunities for automation and AI-enabled agent workflows to reduce routine operational effort and embed these capabilities into everyday Tier 2 and Centre of Excellence delivery.

WHAT YOU’LL DO
Lead global Tier 2 operations and teams
- Lead the day-to-day coordination and delivery of our consolidated Tier 2 Operations function across infrastructure, digital workplace, and cloud operations.
- Own and run the Vulnerability and Patch Management Centre of Excellence, leading its practitioners and establishing consistent operating standards, cadence, and ways of working.
- Establish an effective operational rhythm across teams, including daily stand-ups, triage rotations, escalation protocols, and follow-the-sun handovers.
- Lead and develop a geographically distributed operations team, fostering accountability, customer focus, and continuous learning.
- Partner with Talent Acquisition and managed service providers to build and scale operational support capabilities.
- Manage the onboarding and operational alignment of additional support teams into the Tier 2 function.

Drive operational and service excellence
- Help define and own key Tier 2 performance measures, including mean time to resolution, uptime, automated incident resolution rate, and unplanned work ratio.
- Own vulnerability and patch management measures, including patch compliance, adherence to remediation targets, mean time to remediate, and automated remediation coverage.
- Provide regular performance reporting to the VP of Global Tech Operations, creating visibility into operational trends, vulnerability posture, risks, and capacity considerations.
- Lead operational improvement initiatives that reduce unplanned work and strengthen service reliability.
- Operationalize event-management integrations across platforms such as Datadog, Wiz, CrowdStrike, and ServiceNow.
- Advance the adoption of observability and operational monitoring practices within day-to-day support activities.
- Help mature our 24/7 operating model by improving operational readiness and incident response while identifying opportunities for automation and self-healing.

Strengthen cross-team partnership and transformation
- Oversee escalation processes across Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3 support teams.
- Partner with Service Hub leadership to strengthen escalation service levels, handoff protocols, and shared reporting.
- Collaborate with Service Management on continuous improvement, knowledge management, and root cause analysis.
- Act as operational owner of the patching lifecycle and automated remediation workflows, partnering with Security Operations on zero-day mitigation and vulnerability governance.
- Participate in change coordination and operational reviews to ensure technology changes are visible, coordinated, and tracked.
- Help embed more proactive, intelligence-led support practices across global technology operations.

ABOUT YOU
- You bring strong knowledge of ITIL service management frameworks, with practical experience supporting incident, event, and problem management processes. ITIL v3 or v4 certification is preferred.
- You have experience in technology operations spanning infrastructure operations, platform or cloud operations, or IT service management at a senior management or associate director level.
- You have managed or consolidated multi-domain operational support functions across geographies and time zones.
- You have experience establishing or managing on-call rotations, major incident management, and cross-team escalation frameworks in a global environment.
- You have practical experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Datadog, Dynatrace, Splunk, or equivalent platforms.
- You understand vulnerability management and patching tools such as Wiz, Qualys, Tenable, CrowdStrike, Intune/SCCM, or equivalent solutions, as well as vulnerability scoring, prioritization, and remediation service levels.
- You have familiarity with AWS, Azure, and/or GCP and understand the operational challenges associated with hybrid infrastructure environments.
- You have experience with IT service management platforms, ideally ServiceNow, across incident, change, and problem management workflows.
- You have hands-on experience operationalizing automated remediation workflows, self-healing infrastructure patterns, or event-driven operational automation.
- You have led or owned vulnerability management and patching capabilities at enterprise scale, including compliance reporting and remediation governance.
- You are an experienced people leader who can build and develop operationally focused, geographically distributed teams.
- You are comfortable partnering with engineering, service management, security operations, and senior business leaders.
- You bring an operationally rigorous, data-driven approach, a bias toward action, and a continuous improvement mindset.
- Experience in professional services, financial services, or a similarly complex global enterprise is relevant to this role.
- ITIL v4 Managing Professional or relevant cloud operations certifications, such as AWS Solutions Architect or Azure Administrator, are advantageous. Security certifications such as CompTIA Security+ or CISSP are also advantageous.

This role follows a hybrid model, requiring in-office presence at least 1 day per week .

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn analysis into clear insights and recommendations.
• The ability to drive a piece of work end-to-end with limited direction and perform complex, accurate analysis.
• A continuous-learning mindset and the ability to translate experience into thoughtful recommendations for improvement.
• Strong communication skills, including the ability to structure impactful presentations and updates and clearly communicate insights and implications.
• The ability to lead effective small meetings and contribute confidently in discussions with senior stakeholders.
• A track record of inspiring, motivating, and developing junior team members.

• Deep familiarity with AI and machine-learning technologies and tools, such as Python, R, and OpenAI APIs, and an applied understanding of how they can create business value.

jobs.title: Project Leader - AMS
jobs.description:
About us:
Bain & Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.
Who you will work with
This is an opportunity to be a part of Bain’s AMS CoE, based out of Gurugram office, and specifically support Bain Global case teams on live cases, client development and proposal support. AMS CoE consists of 70+ team members, organized into ~18 teams, working across various sectors such as real estate/construction, heavy machinery, commercial aviation, logistics & transport.
You will work on AMS projects and get exposed to various BCN products ranging from go-to-market strategies, industry analysis, and competitive benchmarking to excel models, survey analysis, and ad-hoc studies, on live client cases as well as for business/client development.
An Associate works as a team member/contributor on BCN cases, driving the analysis on complex cases with some direction from a Project Leader and occasionally leading simple cases independently. In addition, associates help mentor and coach analysts providing feedback. The expectation is to eventually provide significant direction and support to resolve complex issues and effectively manage client and team meetings. As an Associate, the individual would mostly be working on  the following AMS sub-sectors real estate/construction, heavy machinery, commercial aviation, logistics & transport.

About you
- Work experience range in case highest qualification is undergraduate studies – 2-5 years  in consulting/ research/ analytics, with hands on experience in AMS sector (Construction, Real Estate, Manufacturing, Airlines, ports, logistics, factory set-up etc.). Prior experience/ familiarity with AMS sector is a must.
- Work experience range in case highest qualification is postgraduate studies – 0-3 years  in consulting/ research/ analytics, with hands on experience in AMS sector (Construction, Real Estate, Manufacturing, Airlines, ports, logistics, factory set-up etc.). Prior experience/ familiarity with AMS sector is a must.
- Incumbent should be a graduate or post-graduate from top-tier institute or have pursued a commerce/statistical/analytical course from a tier 1 university.
- Candidate should be currently working in strategy consulting/research-oriented set-up and possess acumen to  solve open-ended problems

- Proficient in research and analysis, as well as able to provide solid business judgment to derive answers in situations where  data is not easily available or explicitly published

- Able to interface with primary client contact (Bain case teams from global offices)

- Play a bigger role on long-term AMS   cases typically 3-12 months duration, with frequent interactions with the case team (and potentially end clients whenever opportunity persists)

- Display independent secondary research, analytical, and story lining skills

- Think out-of-the-box to solve for niche case scenarios, through baselining and benchmarking of global best practices

/  Deploy and manage solutions on cloud platforms (AWS/Azure), ensuring performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
/  Implement best practices in DevOps including CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), and monitoring/logging frameworks.
/  Optimize data workflows and system performance for large-scale data processing and real-time/near real-time applications.
/  Work with business stakeholders to understand problem statements and translate them into scalable technical architectures.
/  Contribute to development of reusable technical assets, accelerators, and Bain intellectual property.
/  Support client discussions by articulating technical approaches and trade-offs in a clear and structured manner.
What you’ll do

They should be willing to learn new techniques and be open to solving problems with an interdisciplinary approach. They must have excellent coding skills and should demonstrate a willingness to write modular, reusable, and functional code.

- Drive marketing and commercial enablement - Develop compelling client presentations, proposal materials, and commercial content that communicate Bain's latest perspectives on M&A.
- Support the global distribution of the Global M&A Report and other thought leadership through internal communications, webinars, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
- Contribute content for external marketing channels, including social media, client webinars, and executive speaking engagements.
- Work with practice leaders and marketing teams to amplify Bain's expertise and strengthen engagement with clients and industry audiences.

About You
We're looking for an analytical, curious, and collaborative professional who enjoys translating complex information into compelling insights and practical solutions.

Experience and qualifications
- 5–8 years of professional services experience with an undergraduate degree, or 4–5 years of experience with an MBA or master's degree.
- Experience, expertise, or strong interest in strategy and mergers and acquisitions.
- Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to develop clear recommendations from complex information.
- Demonstrated ability to independently manage workstreams from initial research through final delivery.

Skills and capabilities
- Excellent written communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate research and analysis into compelling, publication-ready thought leadership and client materials.
- Strong commercial awareness and the ability to develop high-quality proposal and marketing content that supports business development.
- Confidence collaborating with diverse stakeholders, including senior leaders, consulting teams, and specialist professionals.
- Ability to lead productive small-group meetings, contribute effectively to senior-level discussions, and communicate recommendations with clarity.
- Familiarity with digital and AI tools, with curiosity about how emerging technologies can improve research, analysis, and solution development.
- A continuous improvement mindset, with the ability to apply lessons learned and identify opportunities to enhance ways of working.
- A collaborative approach and demonstrated ability to coach, motivate, and support junior colleagues.

Additional requirements
- Fluency in English.
- Flexibility to collaborate with colleagues across global time zones.
- Ability to meet in-office requirements: 3x/week in office.

About Us
Bain & Company is a global consultancy that helps the world's most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 61 offices in 38 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries.

We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster and more enduring outcomes. Our 10-year commitment to invest $2 billion in pro bono services brings our talent, expertise and insight to organizations tackling today's urgent challenges.

We earned a platinum rating from EcoVadis, the leading platform for environmental, social and ethical performance ratings for global supply chains, putting us in the top 1 percent among other consulting firms.
Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
